authorization: User explicitly selected AIR as the standard path in the actual ComfyUI environment for personal image-quality evaluation.

deployment.package: Persistent copy of the current worktree runtime, not a junction to the working branch.
deployment.artifacts: Persistent copies of the measured self/cross ELFs, relative ELF paths and SHA-256 verification.
deployment.previous_installation: Previous custom-node junction retained as a backup; its target checkout untouched.
deployment.python_environment: Existing normal ComfyUI interpreter; no package/compiler upgrades.
deployment.startup: Local interpreter startup configuration selects the installed package and persistent artifact directory.

normal_comfyui_generation.workflow: LoadAnimaBF16 -> LoadAttachAnimaXDNAModel -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage; CLIPLoader/Qwen and EmptyCosmosLatentVideo.

limitations.performance_scope: One cold and one resident normal-server request, not a repeated paired benchmark; different seeds. Replay checks validate compatibility, not sampler timing.
